scenarios.title: Equity price file misses its window
scenarios.summary: The primary equity price file does not land by 05:10. The price loader fails, pricing serves stale marks, risk limits evaluate against those marks and P&L flags a spike that is not real.

scenarios.title: FIX session to broker A drops mid-session
scenarios.summary: The FIX gateway to executing broker A loses its session. Orders reject, the drop copy stops mirroring execution reports, fills go missing from trade capture and the blotter diverges from reality while portfolio managers are still trading.

scenarios.title: Primary database connection pool exhausted
scenarios.summary: The primary database runs out of connections. Eight services fail within the same few seconds. Every one of them looks like a root cause on a timeline; only the dependency graph shows that they all sit on the same node.

scenarios.title: Scheduler fault stalls the morning DAG
scenarios.summary: The Airflow scheduler stops dispatching. Every scheduled loader misses its window at once, so the symptoms look like four independent vendor problems rather than one infrastructure fault.

scenarios.title: FX rates go stale, P&L spikes on non-USD book
scenarios.summary: The FX feed stops updating. Non-USD positions are marked at yesterday's rates. The loudest alert on the board is a P&L spike, which is three hops from the actual cause.

scenarios.title: Split not applied to a single name
scenarios.summary: A 4-for-1 split is missing from the corporate actions file. One instrument shows an impossible overnight return. Two alerts total, sitting inside a day with ordinary background noise.

scenarios.title: Message bus degrades and flaps
scenarios.summary: The message bus degrades rather than fails. Latency crosses the threshold, recovers, and crosses again, seven times over forty minutes, while downstream services do the same.

scenarios.title: Two unrelated incidents overlap
scenarios.summary: The locate file from the prime brokers is late while, in the same twenty minutes, the FIX gateway to broker B starts rejecting. The two share no dependency path and must not be merged.
